summary: The frozen real-GT mechanism diagnostic is supportable with scope qualifiers, but the initial candidate bundle cannot support efficacy: GT-defined pair selection, a box-core coordinate-frame bug, and exact direction identities invalidate key candidate interpretations.

excluded: new training or new experiment design

gt_provenance.details: COCO dataset masks are genuine evaluation GT and GT-based oracle use is labeled, but all prediction-derived candidates inherit a GT-selected, COCOeval-GT-matched cohort; only their objective construction is prediction-only.

score_normalization.details: Metrics use GT area and an explicit pixel IoU identity; no normalization by model-output extrema or statistics was found.

result_existence.details: All claimed local mechanism and candidate result files exist and script hashes match, but the original LOCAL_ARTIFACT_SHA256.json does not include any of the nine candidate result files.

dead_code.details: Core frozen and candidate output paths execute; output_overlap_probe.py lines 29-37 compute an unused initial objective/gradient/tangent. Candidate runs lack an independent replay audit.

scope.details: One model, one GT-enriched matched COCO val2017 cohort, one deterministic seed, 300 selected images, 262 valid pairs and 524 targets; no candidate holdout, training, seeds, or official AP.

coordinate_rescaling_identity.evidence: 524/524 saved diagonal gauge transformations changed coefficient cosine with raw-pixel XOR 0 and maximum saved logit difference 0.

candidate_core_coordinates.evidence: box_spatial_probe.py line 39 rasterizes cached inference-grid boxes directly against original-image shape for core06_excl/core08_excl.

gt_free_pair_selection.evidence: frozen_mechanism_probe.py lines 55-79 select GT annotation pairs/ICI strata; lines 93-109 use COCOeval GT matching; candidate scripts filter those saved matched statuses.

region_definitions.evidence: Main GT metric regions are explicit and crowd-excluded. Candidate output/box regions lack saved region-size and empty-region receipts; two core regions use the wrong frame.

control_distinctness.evidence: Frozen zero/random arms are distinct, but q_overlap_strong duplicates q_overlap_excl and all overlap_distill lambda arms duplicate one another.

zero_and_finite_directions.evidence: Frozen oracle explicitly handles zero tangent directions and saved zero count is 0; candidate scripts normalize without active/finite guards. All saved CSV numeric values are finite; six q_overlap pairs have zero objective/no-op results.

weight_identity.evidence: q_overlap_strong is a global 2x scaling of q_overlap_excl before tangent normalization. The overlap_distill preservation term has zero derivative at z=z0, so all five lambda settings produce exactly identical outputs for 524 targets.

claims.claim: A GT-informed coefficient direction improves conditional per-instance pixel metrics on the enriched matched cohort.
Coefficient separation reduces representation overlap but establishes improved GT ownership.
The initial candidate workflow uses GT-free pair selection or is deployable as evaluated.
The box core variants, distillation lambda sweep, and q_overlap_strong arm provide independent candidate efficacy evidence.

limitations: Local source COCO GT JSON is missing, so GT decode and selection could not be independently rerun.
Local tensors/ and per_image/ caches are missing, so decoder and direction replay could not be independently rerun.
The remote Linux directory is not mounted in the current Windows workspace.

The fresh reviewer independently confirmed GT-conditioned selection and the two exact candidate-direction identities, but did not complete the requested A-F verdict; other checklist entries are deterministic executor findings.
Same-family reviewer result is provisional and is not cross-family acceptance.
